buildCommand: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build

api/index.js.//: A mint waits on a 0G Storage write with finalityRequired, which is the safe setting and not a fast one — Hanami documented the same call stalling past ten minutes on a large blob. At the platform's default the function is killed mid-write and the app renders 'Start the API (npm start in api/)' to somebody on a hosted site. The server's own OG_STORAGE_TIMEOUT_MS (60s) gives up first and says which operation did, so this only has to be comfortably longer than that.
